heading: The sticker hunt
lede: Six stickers are hidden around this site, one in each department. They're small and they don't blink at you. Find all six and there's something in it for you.
note: Nothing here is stored anywhere but your own browser, so print it or screenshot it. Clearing your browsing data clears your stickers too.
resetConfirm: Clear all six stickers and start the hunt again?
toastAll: ALL SIX FOUND. GO AND GET YOUR COUPON
